question.en: Discuss the significance of National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) in achieving the objectives of the 'Make in India' initiative.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) in achieving the objectives of the 'Make in India' initiative.

introduction.en: NIMZs are large, integrated industrial townships established under the National Manufacturing Policy (2011) to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.
introduction.hi: NIMZs are large, integrated industrial townships established under the National Manufacturing Policy (2011) to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.

body.en: NIMZs provide world-class infrastructure, single-window clearance, and a conducive regulatory environment. By integrating industrial, residential, and social infrastructure, they reduce logistics costs and improve competitiveness. They act as engines of growth by attracting both domestic and foreign investment, thereby creating large-scale employment and contributing to the manufacturing sector's share in GDP.
body.hi: NIMZs provide world-class infrastructure, single-window clearance, and a conducive regulatory environment. By integrating industrial, residential, and social infrastructure, they reduce logistics costs and improve competitiveness. They act as engines of growth by attracting both domestic and foreign investment, thereby creating large-scale employment and contributing to the manufacturing sector's share in GDP.

conclusion.en: NIMZs are critical for the success of 'Make in India', provided that land acquisition and infrastructure development are executed efficiently through robust PPP models.
conclusion.hi: NIMZs are critical for the success of 'Make in India', provided that land acquisition and infrastructure development are executed efficiently through robust PPP models.

valueAddition.en: NIMZs aim to increase the manufacturing sector's share in GDP to 25%.
